rub.en: When you feel an itch, you often scratch it with your fingers by rubbing your nails on the skin.
rub.zh: 当你感到痒时，通常会用手指去挠，也就是用指甲在皮肤上摩擦。

rule.en: Under Ottoman rule, Istanbul was also transformed into a Muslim cultural and political centre.
rule.zh: 在奥斯曼帝国的统治下，伊斯坦布尔也被改造为一个穆斯林文化和政治中心。

rule.en: The area of reliable English rule, which centred on Dublin, was called the Pale.
rule.zh: 以都柏林为中心、受英国可靠统治的地区被称为“围栏区”（the Pale）。

rule.en: The seasons are cyclical. And procedural refers to a method or set of rules.
rule.zh: 通过这些简单的定义，你大概能猜出线性时间、循环时间，或许还有程序时间的含义，但无论如何我都会做进一步解释。

rule.en: At that time, the Aztec Empire ruled over many smaller peoples in Central Mexico.
rule.zh: 当时，阿兹特克帝国统治着中美洲的许多小部族。

rule.en: The phrasal verb rule out means to dismiss the possibility or idea of something.
rule.zh: 短语动词 rule out 意为排除某种可能性或想法。

runner.en: So, instead Stephen's team used coloured light rings, similar to traffic lights, to warn cyclists and runners.
runner.zh: 因此，斯蒂芬的团队转而使用类似于红绿灯的彩色光环来警告骑自行车的人和跑步者。

runner.en: Animations alert pedestrians but are not suitable for runners and cyclists, who are travelling too fast to react.
runner.zh: 动画可以提醒行人，但不适合移动太快而无法反应的跑步者和骑自行车的人。

runner.en: The link is in the description. The first runner up to Collins dictionary Word of the Year is “task masking”.
runner.zh: 链接就在简介里。柯林斯词典年度词汇的第一个入围者是“任务伪装”。

runner.en: I’ll also discuss some of the other contenders and runners up for the 2025 Word of the Year, including Broligarchy, Task Masking, and Micro-Retirement.
runner.zh: 我还将讨论2025年年度词汇的其他候选词和入围词，包括“富豪兄弟会”、“任务伪装”和“微退休”。

runner.en: For a while, all went well. Fawcett sent intermittent updates via runners who carried letters back to the edges of the jungle, where telegraphs could relay his words to the wider world.
runner.zh: 有一段时间，一切都很顺利。Fawcett 通过信使断断续续地发回消息，信使将信件带到丛林边缘，再由电报将他的话语传送到更广阔的世界。

rude.en: These emails are examples of people being uncivil – an adjective meaning rude or impolite.
rude.zh: 这些邮件都是人们表现得不文明的例子——uncivil是一个形容词，意为粗鲁或不礼貌。

rude.en: In some cases, arriving too early can be rude and arriving too early can be awkward.
rude.zh: 在某些情况下，到得太早反而才是不礼貌的，而且会很尴尬。

rude.en: You, give me that pen! I'm sorry. That was a bit rude.
rude.zh: 喂，把那支笔给我！我很抱歉。刚才那样有点粗鲁。

rude.en: The adjective cheeky means slightly rude in a funny, playful way.
rude.zh: 形容词“cheeky”（厚脸皮的）意味着以一种有趣、开玩笑的方式有点粗鲁。

rude.en: I was almost trying to hide my face, going, "I'm the one with the really rude child."
rude.zh: 我几乎试图藏起脸，心想：“我就是那个带着极度无礼孩子的家长。”

rural.en: People moved from rural areas into the city, in search of factory work.
rural.zh: 人们为了寻找工厂工作，从农村地区涌入城市。

rural.en: Even within the same country, living costs can vary hugely between cities and rural areas.
rural.zh: 即使在同一个国家内，城市和农村地区的生活成本也可能差异巨大。

rural.en: For centuries, many rural communities had access to common land, right?
rural.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多农村社区都可以使用公有地，对吧？

rural.en: Our second female forager, Emily Smith, moved to rural Japan to work on a project cataloguing and collecting wild mushrooms.
rural.zh: 我们的第二位女性采集者 Emily Smith 搬到了日本农村，从事一个对野生蘑菇进行分类和收集的项目。

rural.en: Most North Americans lived in rural communities, and the United States was also much smaller geographically than it is today.
rural.zh: 大多数北美洲人生活在农村社区，而且在地理上美国也比主要小得多。

rug.en: We originally set out to test whether maybe there were these optical illusions at play, so we did a whole bunch of tests where we tried different patterns of rugs, but it turned out that practically every high-contrast pattern, every black and white pattern we used, almost every pattern was really effective at stopping flies.
rug.zh: 我们最初是为了测试是否可能是这些视觉错觉在起作用，所以我们做了一大堆测试，尝试了不同图案的马毯，但结果表明，实际上我们使用的每一种高对比度图案、每一种黑白图案，几乎每一种图案在阻止苍蝇方面都非常有效。

ruin.en: And that's the end of that. So we are hardwired to avoid ruin and just dying.
ruin.zh: 那一切就结束了。所以我们天生就是为了避免毁灭和死亡。

ruin.en: Or will he be remembered as the leader who isolated his country and left it in ruins?
ruin.zh: 还是会被铭记为那个孤立国家并将其化为废墟的领导人？

ruin.en: Aztec ruins lie beneath skyscrapers. Colonial churches stand beside contemporary museums.
ruin.zh: 阿兹特克人的废墟静静躺在摩天大楼下方。殖民时期的教堂与当代博物馆比邻而立。

ruin.en: In 1945, the war ended with Berlin in ruins.
ruin.zh: 1945年，战争以柏林成为一片废墟而告终。

ruin.en: Prices fell dramatically. People were financially ruined.
ruin.zh: 价格急剧下跌。人们倾家荡产。

rumour.en: By being regularly replenished, some dishes are rumoured to last 100 years.
rumour.zh: 通过定期补充，据传有些菜肴能持续100年。

rumour.en: And over the decades, rumours spread: bones were found here or there, or a tribe told stories of a tall white-haired stranger.
rumour.zh: 在随后的几十年里，各种传言四处散播：这里或那里发现了骨头，或者某个部落讲述了关于一个身材高大、白发苍苍的陌生人的故事。

rumour.en: Along the way, there were rumours that he had never really left the secret service, and that he was still working as a British spy.
rumour.zh: 与此同时，有传言称他从未真正离开过秘密情报局，并且仍在为英国担任间谍。

rumour.en: Now, there are some rumours that Caligula murdered Tiberius, with one account having him suffocate the man with a pillow, but these are unsubstantiated.
rumour.zh: 现在，有一些传言称 Caligula 谋杀了 Tiberius，其中一种说法是他用枕头闷死了这个人，但这些都没有证实。

rumour.en: There are rumours he was poisoned, perhaps on Tiberius’ orders, or perhaps it was one of the many bugs that could have proved fatal for travelling soldiers back then.
rumour.zh: 有传言说他是被毒死的，也许是奉了 Tiberius 的命令，或者也许只是当时对旅行中的士兵来说致命的众多病毒之一。

rush.en: He was rushed to hospital, but he didn’t make it; he died 18 days later.
rush.zh: 他被紧急送往医院，但没能挺过去；18 天后他去世了。

rush.en: One day, she made a mistake. I was just in a rush to get home.
rush.zh: 有一天，她犯了一个错误。我当时只是急着回家。

rush.en: Historians often compare it to the California Gold Rush of the 19th century.
rush.zh: 历史学家经常把它与19世纪的加利福尼亚淘金热进行对比。

rush.en: Watchers-on rushed to him and were able to put out the flames.
rush.zh: 围观者冲向他并设法扑灭了火焰。

rush.en: Thousands of gold prospectors rushed into the interior of Brazil.
rush.zh: 成千上万的黄金勘探者涌入巴西内陆。

ruler.en: The Ottoman government and the Ottoman ruler, the Sultan, were doing little to intervene.
ruler.zh: 奥斯曼政府和奥斯曼统治者苏丹几乎没有采取任何干预措施。

ruler.en: These are giant sculptures weighing up to 50 tons and possibly represent their rulers.
ruler.zh: 这些巨大的雕塑重达50吨，可能代表了他们的统治者。

ruler.en: The Shang rulers controlled territory, they had armies and they performed religious rituals.
ruler.zh: 商朝统治者控制领土，他们拥有军队并举行宗教仪式。

ruler.en: During this period, the towns were controlled by local rulers from the Margraviate of Brandenburg.
ruler.zh: 在此期间，这些城镇受勃兰登堡藩侯国（Margraviate of Brandenburg）的当地统治者控制。

ruler.en: We organize them slightly differently than ruler, but you can see the overlap very clearly.
ruler.zh: 我们组织这些维度的方式和 RULER 略有不同，但你能非常清楚地看出两者之间的重叠。

rust.en: JD Vance, with his unusual combination of Yale degree and Rust Belt background, well, he was perfectly placed to do exactly that.
rust.zh: JD Vance 凭借其耶鲁学位和铁锈地带背景这一不同寻常的结合，被完美地放置在能够做到这一点的绝佳位置上。

rust.en: It was also a political commentary on a part of America that he said had been left behind: the Rust Belt, which is the stretch of the northeastern and midwestern United States that was once the industrial heartland, but has been in serious decline.
rust.zh: 这也是对美国某一部分他所说已被遗忘的地区进行的政治评论：铁锈地带（Rust Belt），也就是美国东北部和中西部曾经的工业核心地带，但目前正处于严重衰落之中。

ruthless.en: It sounds like what they are. You have this idea of ruthless edit.
ruthless.zh: 你能解释一下那是什么吗？

ruthless.en: To some, MBS is a visionary moderniser. To others, a ruthless authoritarian.
ruthless.zh: 在某些人眼里，MBS是一位富有远见的现代化主义者。在其他人眼里，他是一个冷酷的独裁者。

ruthless.en: And for me, that's why people see me as ruthless, as you said, because I'm willing to cut relationships.
ruthless.zh: 对我来说，这就是为什么人们认为我无情，正如你所说，因为我愿意切断关系。

ruthless.en: In today’s episode, we’re going to talk about the original Roman despot, the bloodthirsty, depraved, and ruthless Caligula.
ruthless.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们要聊聊最初的罗马暴君——那个嗜血、堕落且冷酷无情的 Caligula。

ruthless.en: Yeah, I've gotten utterly more and more ruthless on it.
ruthless.zh: 是的，我在这方面变得越来越冷酷了。

rubbish.en: If you are listening to this with a cold on a crowded commuter train, well, you’re probably feeling a bit rubbish.
rubbish.zh: 如果你是在一辆拥挤的通勤列车上感冒着听这期节目，嗯，你大概会觉得自己有点糟糕。

rubber.en: Tin was used in industry, and rubber became important due to things like tires and more industrialization.
rubber.zh: 锡被用于工业，而由于轮胎和更多工业化的发展，橡胶变得十分重要。

rubber.en: Two particularly important products were tin and rubber.
rubber.zh: 其中两个特别重要的产品是锡和橡胶。

rubber.en: There are knick-knacks, rubber duckies, streamers.
What’s more, “disease was rampant, and the local Indians who had been brutally and mercilessly attacked by the rubber trappers would kill interlopers on sight.”
rubber.zh: 更不用说，“疾病横行，当地印第安人曾遭到橡胶采伐者的残酷无情袭击，见到外来者就会格杀勿论。”

rubber.en: At first, the government’s response was predictable – tear gas, rubber bullets, arrests, the textbook response of an authoritarian regime in the face of public protest.
rubber.zh: 起初，政府的反应是可以预见的——催泪瓦斯、橡皮子弹、逮捕，这是专政政权面对公众抗议时的标准教科书式回应。

rupture.en: There's a photo that I put up on my Instagram a little while ago, two weeks after I ruptured my Achilles.
rupture.zh: 我前段时间在 Instagram 上发了一张照片，那是我跟腱断裂两周后。
